retainedAttempts.name: direct-native-c-attempt1
retainedAttempts.reason: The first native C build hit a temporary-file rename permission failure in the host temp directory.

retainedAttempts.name: direct-native-c-attempt2
retainedAttempts.reason: The scanner fixture expected an incorrect inactive String Result payload extent (18 rather than the audited 20 bytes).

retainedAttempts.name: direct-native-c-attempt3
retainedAttempts.reason: The descriptor-mutation helper measured primitive Bool index 0 while the mutated case targeted a nominal Bool descriptor at index 1.

retainedAttempts.name: direct-native-c-attempt4
retainedAttempts.reason: Functional scanner and storage cases passed, but the C test main reset saved case/check counters and hid the new scanner checks; attempt 5 removed that suppression and reports truthful totals.

retainedAttempts.name: native-verifier-attempt1
retainedAttempts.reason: Four historical negative controls still expected BoolTag rejection in nominal-Int and refined-String verifier matrices after Bool support was added.

retainedAttempts.name: native-verifier-attempt2
retainedAttempts.reason: The refined-String run returned caseCount 28 per optimization while the audited expected count was 27; the returned case-count literal was corrected before attempt 3.

retainedAttempts.name: full-release-attempt1
retainedAttempts.reason: The initial 37-check Release gate ended with 9 failures after host temporary-project commits returned STORAGE_ACCESS_DENIED; workspace-temp acceptance later passed, but this attempt remains a separate environment failure.
